binary_cot_output_evidence.pinned_official_template_fact: For enable_thinking=True, prompt ends with assistant newline; opening <think> is generated, not prefilled. Complete paired output is parsed correctly by the regex.
binary_cot_output_evidence.impact_boundary: Post-hoc reasons are demonstrably unusable for 3139/3144 rows. Classification raw Y/N/arbitration completions and finish reasons were not saved, so affected classification count and corrected F1 cannot be recovered offline.

findings.summary: No Qwen source sets temperature=0. Main Qwen3 profiles match the official mode-specific sampling guidance; Qwen2.5 vanilla inherits its shipped config. All three official configs have do_sample=true.
findings.historical_caveat: An omitted do_sample inherits loaded model configuration; absence alone does not prove greedy decoding. The original server /data model folders were not recovered.

findings.summary: 14B binary zero-shot explicitly forces do_sample=False; 8B uses mode-specific sampling parameters and no override. It is a decoding-policy difference, not merely a comment typo.
findings.action: Document the actual difference if preserving historical experiments. If claiming controlled strategy/model comparisons, rerun the affected condition under a predeclared matched decoding policy.

findings.summary: All six tree scripts declare DO_SAMPLE=False and save it to settings, but the generate do_sample=DO_SAMPLE argument is commented out. Six stored Qwen tree settings files say false, without proving the runtime used greedy decoding.
findings.action: Correct logging to serialize effective model.generation_config merged with call overrides. Preserve original settings as historical artifacts; do not silently replace them.

findings.summary: Qwen3 nonthinking versus thinking profiles also change temperature .7 to .6, top_p .8 to .95, and max output 20 to 32768. Manual-rule CoT scripts also enable native thinking, so comparison to nonthinking baseline does not isolate the hand-written rules.
findings.action: Describe recommended-profile comparisons rather than an isolated thinking causal effect; compare native-thinking vanilla against native-thinking manual rules to isolate the latter.

findings.summary: Official Qwen2.5-Coder template contains neither enable_thinking nor think markers. Passing enable_thinking=True is inert for that template, not a native reasoning switch. Four classification calls instead explicitly use .6/.95/20, deviating from its shipped .7/.8/20 default.
findings.action: Keep prompt-based reasoning distinct from native thinking. Custom decoding is allowable, but cannot be described as uniformly following shipped model defaults.

findings.summary: Four Qwen3 auxiliary generate_reason calls disable native thinking but retain .6/.95/20, instead of nonthinking .7/.8/20 guidance. They run after label selection and do not feed back into the classifier.
findings.action: Disclose as auxiliary explanation settings; do not infer a classification-score effect.

findings.summary: Binary CoT classification stages allow 2048 output tokens and auxiliary explanations only 96, while keeping thinking enabled. 3139 of 3144 saved auxiliary reasons equal <think>. Complete paired thinking is removed correctly, but malformed/unfinished blocks are not rejected and can be scanned as final decisions.
findings.action: Do not claim saved reasons are usable explanations. For reliable classification validation, save full raw output/finish reason and reject unfinished thinking; a targeted corrected evaluation is needed if final-answer parsing is central, because old raw classifier completions were discarded.

findings.summary: Across all 38 original Qwen sources: 0 runtime seed-setting calls and 0 pinned model revision arguments; historical settings omit the resolved full generation config. Stochastic single runs are not exactly reproducible from current sources alone.
findings.action: Report per-condition effective decoding and versions, set and record seeds, and use repeated stochastic runs or paired uncertainty estimates for new claims.

findings.summary: Original sources truncate inputs: common vanilla/CoT cap4096, vanilla few-shot cap65536 or16384, binary few-shot cap65536, hierarchy coarse cap2048/fine cap8192 with left truncation. A cap is not proof actual truncation happened.
findings.action: Audit actual prompt token lengths before claiming no loss; do not equate different input limits with confirmed lost targets.
